findings.title: Background completion can discard the dispatch’s own result
findings.description: When a background follow-up arrives, `_collect_turns` returns as soon as the ledger is clear and the follow-up result is seen. But after the dispatch’s own result, the follow-up turn may contain only a task notification and no `ResultMessage`; `_read_turn` then returns `None`, and the `ledger.active` check is false, so dispatch returns the text accumulated so far. It can also return after a notification clears the ledger but before the follow-up turn’s result arrives. In either case, the follow-up text/result may be incomplete or omitted. Keep waiting for the relevant turn boundary, and test the notification-only and notification-before-result cases.

findings.title: Failed background-task stops are reported as stopped
findings.description: `_stop_background` logs `stop_task` failures but then clears every task from the ledger and sets `background_tasks_stopped` to the number it attempted to stop. A timed-out or rejected stop request does not establish that the agent stopped; the dispatch then returns success with potentially running agents and metadata claiming they were stopped. Preserve failed task state and report attempted versus confirmed stops distinctly, or fail the dispatch when cleanup cannot be confirmed.
